Subject: Welcome to Redwood — next steps to pick a demo slot

Hi Alex,

Thanks for signing up for Redwood's developer trial — welcome! This is an automated confirmation from our intake flow. Quick notes and next steps so we can get a productive technical session scheduled: 

- Slot selection: Please pick a 30-minute time that works for you via the link below (we surface engineer availability for deep dives). If none of the times fit, reply with 2–3 windows and we’ll coordinate.
  https://calendly.com/redwood/30min-technical-demo
- Helpful context: let us know if you want a full technical integration walkthrough (API keys, sample prompts, SDK install) or a product-level tour.
- Timezone: we try to match the engineer in your region — if you prefer a specific timezone, say so in your reply.

We’ll attach a short suggested agenda and a calendar invite once you pick a slot.

If you need immediate assistance, reply to this thread and I’ll pick it up.

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt | SDR, Redwood Inference

Thanks Hannah — Alex here at FleetOps. I grabbed the signup earlier today. Two quick details:

1) Were in PDT (San Francisco).
2) Wed like the session to be an engineer-to-engineer integration walkthrough: specific asks are how to set up a private deployment, default batching config, and any advice on KV cache sizing for our 4k token sequences.

I tried the Calendly link but the only times I see are mid-afternoon PT; can we do something earlier (10–11am PT) next week? Our main attendees would be me and our infra lead (Priya N.).

Appreciate it — Alex
